description: crate-jmap-jscontact-types/src/lib.rs:1735 declares `let cases: &[(&str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool)] = &[...]` which fails `-D clippy::type_complexity` on Rust 1.95. Fix: introduce a `type CaseRow = (&'static str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool);` alias above the test (or `#[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]` on the test fn with a justification comment). Pre-existing — does not block JMAP-j7pa.1 work but breaks workspace-wide `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` gate.
title: (BUG) clippy type_complexity in jscontact-types lib test
